content.value: A variable plane at a constant distance λ from origin meets the axes in A, B, and C. Through (15) $\Lambda , \mathrm { B } , \mathrm { C }$ planes are drawn parallel to the coordinate planes. Show that the locus of their points of intersection is $x ^ { - 2 } + y ^ { - 2 } + z ^ { - 2 } = \lambda ^ { - 2 }$
